description: This is a source file implementing crit-bit trees (also known as radix trees or prefix trees) in C, providing functions for insertion, lookup, iteration, and traversal of crit-bit trees.

methods.name: struct:cb_node * cb_node_of(const void * p)
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a crit-bit node from an opaque pointer by subtracting 1 from the uintptr_t representation.

methods.name: struct:cb_node * cb_internal_best_match(struct cb_node * p,const uint8_t * k,size_t klen)
methods.description: Finds the best matching node in the crit-bit tree given a key, without performing a final comparison.

methods.name: struct:cb_node * cb_insert(struct cb_tree * t,struct cb_node * node,size_t klen)
methods.description: Inserts a new node into the crit-bit tree or returns an existing node if the key already exists.

methods.name: struct:cb_node * cb_lookup(struct cb_tree * t,const uint8_t * k,size_t klen)
methods.description: Looks up a node in the crit-bit tree by key.

methods.name: enum:cb_next cb_descend(struct cb_node * p,cb_iter fn,void * arg)
methods.description: Recursively descends the crit-bit tree, applying a callback function to each node.

methods.name: void cb_each(struct cb_tree * t,const uint8_t * kpfx,size_t klen,cb_iter fn,void * arg)
methods.description: Iterates over nodes in the crit-bit tree that match a given prefix, invoking a callback on each matching node.
